acceptance: Each option listed is either forwarded to the adapter and covered by the parity test, or removed from the registered specs so it is rejected.
glue and dataproc-serverless register specs for the options their adapters read.
Published bundles and `result_id`s are unchanged, with corpus evidence.
context: These are follow-ups from #2972 (platform options reach adapters) and #2974 (deployment modes). Extend the per-platform parity test from #2972 to these platforms. If the shape of recorded `platform_options` changes, it touches results identity: published `result_id`s must not change, so check against the corpus first.
description:
These options are accepted but never reach the adapter:
- The hand-written `from_config` methods of emr-serverless, dataproc, dataproc-serverless, synapse-spark, fabric-spark and snowpark-connect do not forward `plan_max_depth` or `plan_capture_timeout_seconds`.
- SQLite parses `database_name` but never reads it.
- TimescaleDB `from_config` drops `service_url`.
- glue and dataproc-serverless register no platform options at all.

Separately, supplied options are lifted only in `get_platform_config`, not in the default builder. The default builder was left alone because `DatabaseConfig` has `extra="allow"`, so lifting there would change the recorded `platform_options` shape.
